description: This file implements conflict detection for Font Awesome resources, including web fonts and JavaScript scripts, by testing for conflicts and reporting results via postMessage and console logs.

methods.name: conflictDetection
methods.description: Main function to detect conflicts in Font Awesome resources, sets up message listeners, runs tests, and reports results.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Function to output conflict detection results to console and store in global object.

methods.name: pollUntil
methods.description: Utility function to poll until a condition is met or timeout occurs.

methods.name: detectWebfontConflicts
methods.description: Detects conflicts in web font links and styles.

methods.name: detectSvgConflicts
methods.description: Detects conflicts in inline SVG scripts.

methods.name: setDoneResults
methods.description: Stores the results of conflict detection in the global FontAwesomeDetection object.
